Found it — pid 43000 was **gone** from the real system moments after the daemon's retry loop gave up. It's not stuck; it's just slower than the 700ms budget under load. Root cause of the regression: my reorder removed the fast path where `closeMaster`'s kernel-triggered SIGHUP killed the shell almost instantly — now every force-kill depends purely on the retry loop's fixed budget, and that's sometimes not enough on a loaded machine.

Correct fix: split "capture the descendant snapshot" from "do the killing" so the snapshot happens before any signal (correctness), but the fast `closeMaster`-triggered kernel HUP can still do the actual killing (speed).

Pushed (`78bb9c10`).

Summary: CI was failing on `SessionDaemonEndToEndTests.testKillAllReachesASetsidGrandchild` — a real bug, not a flake. The previous commit (7907754f) moved `forceTerminate` ahead of `closeMaster` to snapshot the process tree before killing, but `closeMaster` still unconditionally closes the pty master fd, which itself triggers a kernel-generated SIGHUP independent of the flag that commit gated. So the shell could still die and orphan its setsid'd grandchild before the snapshot ran.

Fix: split snapshot (`terminationTargets`) from kill (`forceTerminate(targets:)`) so the snapshot always runs first, while `closeMaster`'s fast kernel hangup still does the actual killing in the common case — restoring original speed while closing the real race.

Verified: `SessionDaemonEndToEndTests` 7/7 clean across many repeated runs, full macapp suite (2272 tests) clean except 2 pre-existing `VCSRemoteIntegrationTests` failures (confirmed present on unmodified `master` too, environment-related, unrelated to this fix), `make app-test-supervisor`, `make app-test-scripts`, `make app-lint`, and `make cli-test` all pass.

One caveat: CI's other original failure, `AppStoreCreateWorkroomTests.testCreationTargetAppearsAsTab`, was the known parallel-suite-order flake (passes solo, unrelated to session code) — so CI could still occasionally flag that one; it isn't a regression from this push.
